value.rationale: The all-initial-state kinetic-energy budget is an independent numerical stability requirement in coupled gas-dust source integration. Nonnormal matrices can amplify mixed initial states even with stable eigenvalues; the source only excluded modal amplification. The new structural matrix inequality and incidence singular-gap lemma close that gap uniformly for arbitrary species/signs and show the named switching constant cannot be reduced, giving a precise implementation-relevant energy guarantee.
